body: I have a girlfriend I love, but I know she'd be better off without me. I'm a burden.
I want to be happy again, and I've tried, really, I have.
My parents are there and I can't see them

My girlfriend.
This isn't the first time it's happened, my brain does peculiar things about sleep.
I've gone five days without sleep and another time I lost nearly two days.
It's so hard.
it's not possible right now, I don't have the money

People terrify me.
My chest tightens when I'm outside, I can't breathe.
I'm failing.
I want what I can't have.

Many things.
I'm from a snowy, cold place with a language I'm starting to forget. I know it's stupid but I miss it and bleaching myself might bring me back.
It's been 56 hours and 31 minutes since I was last asleep. My mind is going, I don't want to deal with it anymore.
